admission.justification: Unit tests verify verbatim-vs-stub routing across all ten kinds, exact line alignment and byte-identical re-rendering, preventing broken declaration links or accidentally stubbed Stage 00 formal definitions.

applicability: Deterministic Lean 4 skeleton file rendering and DagDeclarationRef line-range alignment in src/rh_pipeline/lean/stub_emitter.py.
conditions: Emits structure, inductive, class, opaque and axiom always verbatim, def and abbrev verbatim iff preserve_defs=True, and theorem, lemma, instance and non-preserved def/abbrev bodies as sorry EXTRACTED_STUB lines.
Returned DagDeclarationRef spans match rendered 1-based lines exactly, with end_line excluding the trailing EXTRACTED_DEF comment on verbatim blocks and including the sorry line on stub blocks.
exclusions: Omits module and import lines from emitted skeleton files; imports remain on ExtractedModule for DAG construction.
statement: render_skeleton_file emits deterministic self-contained Lean skeleton files with provenance headers, preserving structure/inductive/class/opaque/axiom and (when preserve_defs=True) def/abbrev bodies with EXTRACTED_DEF comments while replacing theorem/lemma/instance (and non-preserved def/abbrev) bodies with EXTRACTED_STUB sorry lines and returning exact DagDeclarationRef line ranges.
title: Deterministic provenance-preserving Lean stub emission
